label: Inter-Sync Gateway Replication (ISGR)
type: a Sync Gateway-to-Sync-Gateway (active/local to passive/remote) replication topology, configured through the identical replication schema as a database's embedded replications object (field-for-field identical across configuration-schema-database.md and configuration-schema-isgr.md). Auto-purge on channel-access revocation defaults OFF for ISGR (opt-in via purge_on_removal) - the exact reverse of the Sync-Gateway-to-Couchbase-Lite default.
note: Resolves the round's flagged near-miss: no source page anywhere in this batch names XDCR, Couchbase Server cross-cluster replication, or draws any comparison to the xdcr:* family - configuration-schema-isgr.md, the page most likely to state a connection if one existed, never uses the word 'XDCR' at all. Kept fully separate from xdcr:replication per the standing no-silent-merge rule; this is confirmation by absence, not a guess.
qualifying_note_round_28: This 'no relationship, confirmed by absence' finding is REFINED, not reversed, by round 28's dedicated ISGR-family batch. Four of the five ISGR-specific pages read that round (sync-inter-syncgateway-conflict-resolution.md, sync-inter-syncgateway-manage.md, sync-inter-syncgateway-monitor.md, sync-inter-syncgateway-run.md) independently confirm the same silence on XDCR, each explicitly checked and found empty. The fifth, sync-inter-syncgateway-overview.md, is the one page in the whole corpus that DOES draw an explicit comparison - three mentions, including 'Couchbase Server uses XDCR similarly to replicate between Couchbase Server clusters' (filed as isAnalogousTo server:xdcr) and a narrower, unambiguous claim that ISGR's collection-remapping mechanism 'adapts the mapping concept from XDCR' (filed as sgw:collection-mapping isAnalogousTo xdcr:explicit-mapping). Both are correctly scoped analogies (a shared cross-cluster-replication purpose, and one specific borrowed mechanism) - neither states ISGR IS XDCR or shares its implementation, so this record's core claim stands. Separately, round 28's server-compatibility-xdcr.md states Sync Gateway 4.0's native sgw:bidirectional-xdcr is 'a simpler and more efficient alternative to Inter-Sync Gateway Replication' - filed as sgw:bidirectional-xdcr supersedes sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication (relations/supersedes.json). This does not mean ISGR is deprecated or removed: it remains fully documented as a live feature across all five round-28 ISGR pages, none of which point forward to bi-directional XDCR.
